mapper.sql: id, job_name, business_date, attempt, status, started_at, ended_at, error, created_at, updated_at, data_scope, input_hash, owner_id, heartbeat_at, retry_of, data_status
mapper.select: SELECT FROM job_execution WHERE job_name=#{jobName} AND business_date=#{businessDate} AND data_scope=#{dataScope} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*)+(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_attempt_history h JOIN job_execution j ON j.id=h.job_id AND j.tenant_id=h.tenant_id WHERE j.job_name=#{jobName} AND j.business_date=#{businessDate} AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.execution_json,'$.data_scope'))=#{dataScope}) FROM job_execution WHERE job_name=#{jobName} AND business_date=#{businessDate} AND data_scope=#{dataScope}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO job_execution(job_name, business_date, attempt, status, started_at, data_scope, input_hash, retry_of,reservation_bytes) VALUES(#{jobName}, #{businessDate}, #{attempt}, 'PENDING', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{dataScope}, #{inputHash}, #{retryOf},#{reservationBytes})
INSERT INTO job_stage(job_id, stage_name, status, started_at) VALUES(#{id}, #{stage}, 'RUNNING', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT id, job_id, stage_name, status, started_at, ended_at, error, data_status, details_json FROM job_stage WHERE job_id=#{id} ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM job_execution WHERE status='PENDING' AND job_name IN ('DAILY','WEEKLY') ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM job_execution WHERE status='PENDING' AND job_name IN ('MARKET_HISTORY','MARKET_UNIVERSE','MARKET_FULL') ORDER BY CASE job_name WHEN 'MARKET_UNIVERSE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,id LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE job_execution SET status='RUNNING', owner_id=#{owner}, heartbeat_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), started_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE job_execution SET input_hash=#{hash} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM job_execution WHERE status IN ('RUNNING', 'CANCEL_REQUESTED', 'TIMEOUT_REQUESTED') AND heartbeat_at<DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL 2 MINUTE)
mapper.update: UPDATE job_stage SET status=#{status}, ended_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), error=#{error}, data_status='UNAVAILABLE' WHERE job_id=#{jobId} AND status='RUNNING'

sql.where: NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM job_execution child WHERE child.retry_of=job_execution.id AND child.tenant_id=job_execution.tenant_id) AND job_name=#{type}

mapper.select: SELECT FROM job_execution ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE job_execution SET status=#{status}, data_status=#{dataStatus}, error=#{error}, ended_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{jobId} AND owner_id=#{ownerId} AND ( (status='RUNNING') OR (status='CANCEL_REQUESTED' AND #{status}='CANCELLED') OR (status='TIMEOUT_REQUESTED' AND #{status}='TIMED_OUT') )

UPDATE job_execution SET ended_at=CASE WHEN status='PENDING' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ELSE ended_at END, data_status=CASE WHEN status='PENDING' THEN 'UNKNOWN' ELSE data_status END, error=#{reason}, status=CASE WHEN status='PENDING' THEN 'CANCELLED' ELSE #{status} END WHERE id=#{jobId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') AND owner_id=#{ownerId}
UPDATE job_stage SET details_json=#{detailsJson} WHERE job_id=#{jobId} AND stage_name=#{stageName} AND status='RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM job_execution WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE job_execution SET status='PENDING',attempt=#{attempt},data_scope=#{dataScope},input_hash=#{inputHash},reservation_bytes=#{reservationBytes},started_at=NULL,ended_at=NULL,heartbeat_at=NULL,owner_id=NULL,error=NULL,data_status=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('FAILED','INTERRUPTED','CANCELLED','TIMED_OUT')
mapper.select: SELECT job_id,attempt,execution_json,content_hash FROM job_attempt_history WHERE job_id=#{id} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_attempt_history WHERE job_id=#{id}
